name: round 1: The core
tests: list prints the seven agents, one line each as <id>\t<name>\t<kind>, in catalogue order
list --json prints a JSON array of { id, name, kind } in catalogue order
link claude prints one JSON line { agent, kind: "url", value: "https://claude.ai/new?q=…" } with the prompt URL-encoded
link chatgpt prints one JSON line { agent, kind: "url", value: "https://chatgpt.com/?q=…" } with the prompt URL-encoded
link perplexity prints one JSON line { agent, kind: "url", value: "https://www.perplexity.ai/search?q=…" } with the prompt URL-encoded
link le-chat prints one JSON line { agent, kind: "url", value: "https://chat.mistral.ai/chat?q=…" } with the prompt URL-encoded
link cursor prints one JSON line { agent, kind: "deeplink", value: "cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/prompt?text=…" } with the prompt URL-encoded
link claude-code prints one JSON line { agent, kind: "command", value: "claude …" } with the prompt single-quoted
link codex prints one JSON line { agent, kind: "command", value: "codex …" } with the prompt single-quoted
link URL-encodes Unicode, emoji, newlines, quotes, spaces, +, & and # exactly as encodeURIComponent does
link single-quotes a command for a POSIX shell: each ' becomes '\'' and $, `, \, " and newlines stay as they are
link uses the prompt exactly as given: leading and trailing spaces and newlines are kept
link <id> --file <path> reads the prompt from a UTF-8 file, unchanged (its final newline included)
link accepts a url of exactly 8000 characters and refuses one of 8001 with exit 3
link measures the 8000-character limit on the encoded link, not on the raw prompt (exit 3)
the 8000-character limit applies to the cursor deeplink (exit 3) but never to commands
link refuses an unknown agent with exit 2 and an error: line on stderr
link refuses an empty or whitespace-only prompt with exit 2
link refuses a missing prompt, a missing agent, or both a prompt and --file, with exit 2
link refuses a --file that cannot be read with exit 2
the CLI refuses no command, an unknown command and an extra argument with exit 2
